intro: A bed that’s as strong as it is stylish, Zurina blends the richness of a dark wood grain finish with modern durability. Designed for comfort and ease, it turns your room into a restful retreat.

features.title: Dark wood grain finish for timeless elegance
features.text: The rich, dark wood grain adds a sophisticated warmth to your bedroom, creating a space that feels inviting and effortlessly stylish.

features.title: Inbuilt box storage for organised living
features.text: With inbuilt box storage, your essentials stay neatly tucked away, keeping your bedroom clutter-free and beautifully serene.

features.title: Abrasion and scratch resistance for everyday life
features.text: Built to handle life’s little bumps, its scratch-resistant surface keeps the bed looking pristine, even through daily wear and tear.

features.title: Sturdy metal understructure for reliable support
features.text: Crafted with a strong metal frame, this bed ensures unmatched stability, giving you the peace of mind to rest easy every night.

features.title: Engineered for strength, designed for style
features.text: Designed with premium engineered wood, it delivers a sturdy yet elegant foundation, bringing together beauty and resilience in one stunning package.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
